correctness.rationale: Maximal independence is equivalent to avoiding cyclic 11 and 000; the unique periodic three-state path gives a signed integer transfer trace without double-counting. Unweighted trace P_n has recurrence P_n=P_{n-2}+P_{n-3} with (3,0,2); Q_n containing a marked vertex has (1,0,1). Finite recurrence-state transitions establish P_n mod 2 period 7, mod 4 period 14, and Q_n mod2 period 7, not an empirical extrapolation. Odd P_n makes all W odd; at n=8 mod14, character expansion modulo 4 yields W= P_n-2|b|Q_n=2 mod4. Explicit trace-zero seeds at n=4,9,11,15,16 cover singular residue representatives, and 7-letter transfer J with J^2=I extends seeds by 14. Boundary n=3 and unnormalized convention checked. Independent integer checks recomputed all five seed traces, J^2 and recurrence parity patterns; this is supplementary, not the all-n proof.
